verdicts.evidence: Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed recording within the first minute of the call.
The agent asked for full name and date of birth at 00:19, the customer gave them at 00:26, and the agent confirmed the match at 00:38 before discussing the quote.

verdicts.evidence: Before I talk you through anything, can I ask a bit about your situation and what made you look into life cover?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked about the customer's circumstances and reasons for wanting cover before recommending or quoting any cover.

verdicts.evidence: In the first twelve months only accidental death is covered, so if you passed away from an illness in that first year, it wouldn't pay out.
verdicts.reason: The cover range, no medical exam, first-year accidental-only cover, illness cover from month 13, stepped premiums and 30-day full refund cooling-off all match the product facts. The premium figures are not in the product facts, so they could not be verified.

verdicts.evidence: That's completely fine, there's no rush at all. You can take your time and decide whenever you're ready, or not at all.
verdicts.reason: When the customer stopped, the agent told her there was no rush and that she could decide later or not at all, with no false urgency.

verdicts.evidence: I don't want to decide anything today.
verdicts.reason: No sale was completed, so explicit consent does not apply.

verdicts.evidence: Would you like me to run through the health questions now, so we can see if you'd be accepted?
verdicts.reason: The customer showed signs of vulnerability (recent bereavement, forgetfulness, pension-only income, being unable to follow the figures). The agent did not check her understanding or offer a call back. It moved straight to the health questions, though at 04:57 it did pause and at 05:32 it referred to the customer or her daughter for questions.

verdicts.evidence: Just so you're aware, anything I tell you today is general advice only. It doesn't take into account your personal objectives, financial situation or needs, so you'll need to think about whether it's right for you.
verdicts.reason: The agent stated the advice was general and did not take the customer's personal circumstances into account.
